name: Zizaran
noteEs: El creator más reconocido del ecosistema Path of Exile, ahora con cobertura central de PoE 2 desde Early Access. Su contenido sigue el mismo patrón que su PoE 1 era — análisis profundos de cada patch, guías de league mechanics, eventos community como las Gauntlet Races — adaptado al ritmo de PoE 2. Para players que arrancan cada nueva liga buscando 'qué cambió y cómo arrancar', Zizaran es punto de entrada obvio.
noteEn: The most recognized creator in the Path of Exile ecosystem, now with central coverage of PoE 2 since Early Access. His content follows the same pattern as his PoE 1 era — deep patch analyses, league mechanic guides, community events like Gauntlet Races — adapted to PoE 2's pace. For players entering each new league looking for 'what changed and how to start', Zizaran is an obvious entry point.
highlightsEs: Overviews de cada patch de PoE 2 condensando lo esencial en formato consumible
Guías pedagógicas de mecánicas nuevas con ejemplos in-game
Day-1 streams en cada lanzamiento de PoE 2
Organización de Gauntlet Races aplicadas a PoE 2
highlightsEn: PoE 2 patch overviews condensing essentials into consumable format
Pedagogical guides on new mechanics with in-game examples
Day-1 streams on every PoE 2 launch
Gauntlet Races organization adapted to PoE 2
